<p align="center"><strong>Ending 04 of 06 - The Watcher at the Window</strong></p>


<p align="center">The cat leads you through the gate without once looking back. At the edge of town, you hear a third set of footsteps stop when yours do.</p>

<p align="center">At home, the cat takes its place at your bedroom window. All night, something outside politely asks to be let in. It uses Elias's voice.</p>

<p align="center">THE WATCHER AT THE WINDOW - You both escaped. The cat keeps the thing outside. Every October 31, you remember to shut the windows before dark.</p>
